The gun rolls its ejection port toward the shooter, the RIGHT hand lifts the bolt handle and pulls the bolt back, leaves it open, then N times drops out of view, comes back with a cartridge (`round` bone) over the port and thumbs it down into the magazine; finally it takes the knob again, pushes the bolt forward, turns it down and returns to the wrist.
